{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Confirm 'completed' status and exclude non-completed
completed_data = data[data['status'] == 'completed'].copy()

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = completed_data[completed_data['revenue'] == '999999.99']

# Parse revenue as float after stripping commas
completed_data['revenue_numeric'] = completed_data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for any QA orders
print(f'QA orders found: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Check if revenue is plausible (e.g., > 0 and not extreme)
# We'll assume any revenue > 10000 is suspicious, but there are none
high_revenue = completed_data[completed_data['revenue_numeric'] > 10000]
print(f'High revenue (>10000) orders: {len(high_revenue)}')

# Check the distribution of customer_segment and channel
print('\nCustomer segment distribution:')
print(completed_data['customer_segment'].value_counts())

print('\nChannel distribution:')
print(completed_data['channel'].value_counts())

# Check for missing age (sentinel -1)
print('\nMissing age (sentinel -1):', (completed_data['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check conversion rate per channel and segment
conversion_by_channel_segment = completed_data.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().reset_index()
conversion_by_channel_segment['conversion_rate_pct'] = conversion_by_channel_segment['converted'] * 100
print('\nConversion rate by channel and segment:')
print(conversion_by_channel_segment)"}
